title: Final State for (a)
description: Essential Criteria: The student must correctly state the Clebsch-Gordan coefficient for |3/2, 3/2> as |1, 1> |1/2, 1/2>.

title: Final State for (b)
description: Essential Criteria: The student must correctly express |3/2, 1/2> in terms of the basis states with the correct coefficients.

title: I-spin Conservation for (c)
description: Important Criteria: The student must correctly analyze the I-spin states for K-p reactions and derive the relative rates.

title: I-spin Conservation for (d)
description: Important Criteria: The student must correctly analyze the I-spin states for K-n reactions and derive the relative rates.

title: Common Errors
description: Pitfall Criteria: The student should avoid common mistakes such as incorrect application of Clebsch-Gordan coefficients or miscalculating the I-spin states.
